title: Creating world's first digital identity for farmers using satellite imagery and AI

ms.promise:
This milestone will include processing of SatEO imagery data, i.e. deeply-resolved Sentinel-2 from 10 meter to 1 meter per pixel resolution across the entire crop-land (agricultural regions) in Kenya to start with including 10-spectral bands, this will enable a country-wide mosaic, i.e. base-map cloud-free up-to-date which is currently not available or accessible and will serve as the baseline for interpreting agricultural land, practices and fundamental layer for digitisation of smallholder farmers land. The output that will be produced during this milestone will include:
・Deeply-resolved Sentinel-2 from 10m to 1m (10 spectral bands) across the entire agricultural region of Kenya, based on 2023 crop season dates, cloud-free. 
・The imagery processed in Geotiff and served in a digital base-map (custom web-application) visualised.
・Creation of manual training data, i.e. manually digitised agricultural field boundaries across the entire country of Kenya, i.e. based on the same SatEO imagery data, this will include minimum of 60,000 field boundaries (polygons) and 35,000 hectares.
ms.criteria:
The acceptance criteria will be as follows:
・Successfully processed SatEO imagery across the entire area of interest (Kenya) 
・Successfully custom created web-app with the mosaic SatEO at 1m data visualised and accessible
・Successfully created/labeled 60,000 field boundaries

・Deeply-resolved Sentinel-2 from 10m to 1m (10 spectral bands) across the entire agricultural region of Kenya, based on 2023 crop season dates, cloud-free.

・The imagery processed in Geotiff and served in a digital base-map (custom web-application) visualised.
・Conclusion and report: Both the web application which will be publicly available in a www url and also the API token (unique credentials) will be shared with the reviewer and the Cardano ecosystem. The imagery processed in Geotiff’s has been completed and the field boundaries delineated and available in Geojson/Shape files is available in download links here (total dataset includes 422,000 field boundaries, i.e. we could perhaps create a smaller sample data set to share). ms.promise:
The output of this milestone will include the following:
・Successfully developed model for automatically delineated field boundaries across entire crop-land area of Kenya at 1 meter per pixel and the KPI of this milestone will be to achieve higher than 0.90 IoU accuracy in the output (i.e. 90%). This process will include significant model training and be compute intensive (GPU/HPC) which is why we have included 3 months for this stage.
・Successfully post-processed all field boundaries with deep-resolution S2 imagery at 1 meter and loaded in our AWS cloud environment and subsequently in the web-application.
ms.criteria: The acceptance criteria will be the accuracy of the output, i.e. 0.90 and above as well as the successful completion and creation of a fully working web-application with this data displayed and visualised to stakeholders and broader Cardano community.

ms.promise:
The fourth milestone and final milestone of the project will include following outputs:
・Successfully established partnerships in the agricultural value chain in Kenya, including third party partners both from the private sector, including a minimum of two private corporate/enterprise clients. 
・Successfully implemented and digitised farm and field level data on blockchain and accessible to smallholder farmers, including 50,000 fields as the initial data-set, which is also leveraged through the Cardano community to create greater impact and additional value-add and services/solutions on top. 
・Project Closeout Report and Project Closeout Video (PCR and PCV)
ms.criteria: The validation criteria will include 2 secured partnerships in Kenya, corporate partners and clients who will leverage this data in their value-and supply chain to bring greater value to smallholder farmers in the region. Additionally, 50,000 fields and agricultural farms digitised in Kenya and accessible on blockchain and open to community and end-users (farmers) to improve their sustainability and profitability. The end goal in this project is to be able to leverage the Cardano community to extend the benefits and value-add that the ecosystem can bring to these farmers through aux services.
